orbit/01.caption: You never tried to be the centre yet you always were
options: You never tried to be the centre yet you always were
That shy smile hides the bravest heart I know
Standing there like the world is gentle because you are

orbit/02.caption: This smile carried me through days you never knew about
options: This smile carried me through days you never knew about
Wind in your hair and nothing but kindness in your eyes
You laugh with your whole heart and I never said thank you

orbit/03.caption: That little girl already knew how to make the world smile
options: That little girl already knew how to make the world smile
Before I ever knew you you were already this full of light
The same pure heart then and now

orbit/04.caption: Nobody else can make me laugh with one silly face
options: Nobody else can make me laugh with one silly face
You never hide your silly side from me and I love that
Even your goofiest faces feel like home

orbit/05.caption: That quiet look that says everything will be okay
options: That quiet look that says everything will be okay
So calm so gentle and you never once asked for too much
Your stillness has always been my safest place

orbit/06.caption: You turn the most ordinary days into something worth remembering
options: You turn the most ordinary days into something worth remembering
Your playful side is my favourite kind of chaos
Wherever you go you leave a little more joy behind

orbit/07.caption: You carry sunshine even when the day has none to give
options: You carry sunshine even when the day has none to give
That warm smile that always makes me feel welcome
The light finds you because you give so much of it

orbit/08.caption: You listen like every word I say matters
options: You listen like every word I say matters
That patient look you give me when I talk too much
Being near you is still my favourite journey

orbit/09.caption: You feel things deeply and I did not always see that
options: You feel things deeply and I did not always see that
Even in your quiet moments there is so much strength
Grace looks a lot like you lost in thought

orbit/10.caption: The softest heart I have ever been trusted with
options: The softest heart I have ever been trusted with
That small smile when you think nobody is watching
You stay gentle in a world that rarely is

orbit/11.caption: I should have noticed when your light felt dim
options: I should have noticed when your light felt dim
Even in the dark you were always quietly there
Some days you held everything in and I missed it

orbit/12.caption: I want to know even the parts you keep hidden
options: I want to know even the parts you keep hidden
You never have to hide anything from me
Behind the camera a heart that loves so quietly

orbit/13.caption: Even when you turn away I find my way back to you
options: Even when you turn away I find my way back to you
You never needed to be seen to make everything glow
I never want you to feel you walk alone

orbit/14.caption: You always find calm even when the sky is uncertain
options: You always find calm even when the sky is uncertain
Looking at the horizon like you still believe in tomorrow
You shelter everyone and still keep your eyes on the sea

orbit/15.caption: Golden hour suits you because you are made of warmth
options: Golden hour suits you because you are made of warmth
That look over your shoulder still makes my heart stop
Every sunset reminds me of the way you look back at me

orbit/16.caption: All those lights and you were still the brightest one
options: All those lights and you were still the brightest one
Your happiness is the only celebration I will ever need
You move through life and pull everyone into the joy

orbit/17.caption: Free like the wind and still you chose to stay
options: Free like the wind and still you chose to stay
You make the sky feel a little closer
Even the sun squints a little when you smile

orbit/18.caption: That sleepy smile is where all my worries go to rest
options: That sleepy smile is where all my worries go to rest
So soft so safe so completely you
You make comfort feel like a person

orbit/19.caption: The sun was setting but my sun was right there
options: The sun was setting but my sun was right there
At the edge of the sea with all that calm in you
Every ending looks hopeful when you are standing in it

orbit/20.caption: You grow kindness wherever you stand
options: You grow kindness wherever you stand
That shy smile among the leaves undoes me
Quiet and green and gentle just like your heart

orbit/21.caption: That fearless little girl still lives in your heart
options: That fearless little girl still lives in your heart
Born ready to dance through every festival of life
You have always held life with both hands

orbit/22.caption: Little stars around you as if the sky already knew
options: Little stars around you as if the sky already knew
You hide behind the phone but never behind your heart
Even your doodles know you belong among the stars

orbit/23.caption: Nervous and smiling anyway that is your quiet courage
options: Nervous and smiling anyway that is your quiet courage
You show up with your whole heart every single time
That excited little grin I want to protect forever

orbit/24.caption: Proud of you more than I ever said out loud
options: Proud of you more than I ever said out loud
You walk into every room like you belong and you do
Confident and kind a rare mix and all you

orbit/25.caption: You smile down at the ground and the whole room turns golden
options: You smile down at the ground and the whole room turns golden
All that colour around you and your heart still shines brighter
Playful shy and warm the best parts of every day

orbit/26.caption: I love you most in the moments you do not pose
options: I love you most in the moments you do not pose
Lost in your own world and still you make room for me
Focused gentle real the version of you I adore

orbit/27.caption: You laugh with your eyes closed like joy is something you feel
options: You laugh with your eyes closed like joy is something you feel
Peace signs and happy eyes you are my calm
Your happiness is my favourite thing to see

orbit/28.caption: Those steady eyes have forgiven me more than I deserved
options: Those steady eyes have forgiven me more than I deserved
You look at me like you still see the good in me
Calm patient and honest everything I want to become

orbit/29.caption: I want to be the reason for this laugh again
options: I want to be the reason for this laugh again
This laugh is the sound I want to hear forever
When you laugh like this the whole world feels lighter

orbit/30.caption: Your quiet confidence makes me want to be better
options: Your quiet confidence makes me want to be better
That little smile tells me you believe in me
Strong and soft at the same time only you

orbit/31.caption: The wind keeps moving but you stay so steady
options: The wind keeps moving but you stay so steady
You hold yourself together so gracefully even on windy days
Every little gesture of yours feels like poetry to me

orbit/32.caption: You find happiness in the simplest moments and share it with me
options: You find happiness in the simplest moments and share it with me
Messy hair wide smile and a heart wide open
Free and fearless the way I always want you to feel

orbit/33.caption: You laugh like the world has never been unkind to you
options: You laugh like the world has never been unkind to you
That shy laugh still feels like the very first time
Bright as the city lights and twice as warm

orbit/34.caption: Warm like an old song I never get tired of
options: Warm like an old song I never get tired of
You make every era feel like it was made for you
A timeless soul with the kindest smile

orbit/35.caption: You find wonder in the smallest things and I love that
options: You find wonder in the smallest things and I love that
Ordinary aisles feel like an adventure when you walk them
Your curious heart turns little moments into memories

orbit/36.caption: Home is wherever this cheeky grin is
options: Home is wherever this cheeky grin is
That cheeky grin wins every argument we ever have
You make me smile without even trying

orbit/37.caption: This is what you look like to me made of light
options: This is what you look like to me made of light
You glow from the inside out
Even the light wraps around you like it knows

orbit/38.caption: Your smile makes even grey walls feel like spring
options: Your smile makes even grey walls feel like spring
You bloom wherever life plants you
Happy looks so natural on you I want to keep it there

orbit/39.caption: You see right through me and still you stay
options: You see right through me and still you stay
Honest eyes that never once lied to me
Strong steady and true the person I trust most

orbit/40.caption: A soft smile that quietly fixes my worst days
options: A soft smile that quietly fixes my worst days
Simple and real that is what I love about you
You never pretend and that makes you so rare

stars/01.caption: Playful and graceful at once like only you can be
options: Playful and graceful at once like only you can be
You make every corner feel like a stage for joy
Your playful heart keeps mine young

stars/02.caption: The little girl who would one day become my sun
options: The little girl who would one day become my sun
Even then you looked at the world so thoughtfully
That serious little face already held a gentle soul

stars/03.caption: Even tired you still save a smile for me
options: Even tired you still save a smile for me
That sleepy smile is the softest thing I know
I miss these unguarded moments with you the most

stars/04.caption: I want to be there in your dark days too
options: I want to be there in your dark days too
Even on your darkest days you were still my light
You never have to pretend to be okay with me

stars/05.caption: Like the flowers behind you you make everything gentler
options: Like the flowers behind you you make everything gentler
Smiling at something only you can see
Growing into yourself and I am so proud of you

stars/06.caption: Leaning on the wall but always holding me up
options: Leaning on the wall but always holding me up
Easy laughter and an open heart that is you
You make staying feel like the easiest choice

stars/07.caption: You soften every noise in my head
options: You soften every noise in my head
Lost in your music and still the calmest place I know
A little butterfly landed on the gentlest soul

stars/08.caption: Patient with me through every detour I put us through
options: Patient with me through every detour I put us through
That gentle smile that says I am still here
You make every long road feel shorter

stars/09.caption: You glow quietly and never ask for anything back
options: You glow quietly and never ask for anything back
That shy little smile has always been my favourite secret
Simple moments with you are my biggest treasures

stars/10.caption: Grace and warmth wrapped in golden light forever my Krishi
options: Grace and warmth wrapped in golden light forever my Krishi
And through it all you were always my sun
Every star leads back to this gentle soul
